# Video Saver for Skool (Skool Video Downloader)

> Chrome extension that downloads Skool videos as MP4 files. Works with Skool's native player, YouTube, Loom, Vimeo and Wistia. Videos are processed locally in the browser. 5 free downloads included.

## Key facts
- Also searched as: skool video downloader, skool video saver, download skool videos.
- Supported players: Skool native (Mux/HLS), YouTube, Loom (including password-protected), Vimeo, Wistia.
- Works on classroom lessons and community post videos you already have access to.
- Free: 5 downloads in total (trial). Monthly: $20/month. Lifetime Pro: one-time, tiered early-bird pricing (see pricing.md).
- Refunds: 14 days. Support: hello@skoolvideosaver.com
